name: 4 lines Premium 2.0 + watch and tablet 50% off - long calculation
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: structured, detail-oriented.
scripted_messages: Hello, I'll lay out what I need in order. 1) Four lines on Premium 2.0, we have our own unlocked phones. 2) One cellular Apple Watch line and one tablet line added, and I understand Premium 2.0 gives 50% off one watch or tablet plan per line. 3) The site shows $220 a month for the four phone lines. What's the monthly total for everything, including the 50% off?
Of course. Take your time, tyt.
Thank you, still here, no rush.
Thanks. Does the 50% off apply to both the watch and the tablet, or just one of them per Premium line?
I see. And when the discount applies, does it show as a credit or is it taken off the line price directly?
Understood. So what would my first bill be with all taxes and fees included?
That's a little higher than I expected for the first month, but I appreciate how thorough and kind you were with all my questions.
No, that's all. Have a great rest of your day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: second wait message (long calculation)
before message 5: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 8: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 9: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 10: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
